hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was scrubbing the hearth, my heart racing as I heard soft footsteps approaching. I loosened my stays, my hands shaking, before the ball... my corset slipped. Then, I felt a pair of hands gently lacing it back into place. It was the most intimate thing I've ever experienced.
caption:
Maid meets mystery in the dimly lit halls. Did you catch my blush?
